# Administrative Capital for Urban Development (ACUD)

The Administrative Capital for Urban Development is the company responsible for developing Egypt's New Capital into a smart, sustainable city and a new centre for government, business, culture and innovation. ACUD was founded in 2016 and has worked with local and international partners to build connected districts, modern infrastructure and an urban experience for residents and visitors.

## Services named on the site
A Citizens Portal (residents and owners) and a Developers Portal (real estate developers): https://portal.acudeg.com/acudportal/

## Milestones as stated by ACUD
2016 foundation; 2017 ground-breaking for phase 1; 2018 Central Business District and Iconic Tower construction; 2019 landmark openings; 2020 key infrastructure across major districts; 2021 Iconic Tower structural top-out; 2022 Light Rail Transit operation; 2023 relocation of the Cabinet and 34 ministries to the Government District; 2024 integration of city operations and data centres; 2025 commercial expansion; 2026 phase 1 operational (ACUD states 70%+ completion of phase 1).

## City Operations Center (as described by ACUD)
A unified command centre that monitors and manages public utilities and urban services (smart utilities, operator coordination, intelligent transportation, data integration).

## Districts named on the site
Government District; Central Business District (CBD); City of Arts and Culture; the Green River and Nation's Park; Nation's Plaza and Central Bus Terminal. The residential districts (such as R7) are not described on this page.

## Contact (public)
info@acud.eg; New Capital, Cairo, Egypt.
